name: ASML

eyebrow.en: ASML Holding N.V. · NASDAQ-listed shares (1 ADR = 1 share) · Veldhoven, Netherlands
eyebrow.zh: 阿斯麦控股 · 纳斯达克上市股份（1 ADR = 1 股）· 荷兰费尔德霍芬

title.en: The only company that makes the machines that print AI chips.
title.zh: 全球唯一一家制造印刷 AI 芯片机器的公司。

lede.en: ASML is the only maker of EUV lithography machines, the tools needed to print the most advanced chips. Sales rose 21% to €9.3B (about $10.8B) last quarter, and the 2026 guide was raised to €43–45B as memory and logic makers add capacity for AI. The catches: China is still about a fifth of sales and faces tighter US export rules, and the stock trades at about 55 times trailing earnings.
lede.zh: 阿斯麦是全球唯一的 EUV 光刻机制造商，最先进的芯片都需要这种设备来印刷。上季销售增长 21% 至 93 亿欧元（约 108 亿美元），存储和逻辑芯片厂商为 AI 扩产，2026 年指引上调至 430–450 亿欧元。隐忧在于：中国仍约占销售的五分之一，并面临更严格的美国出口管制；股价约为过去十二个月盈利的 55 倍。

s.zh: 过去四季每股收益约 $32 · 预期约 31 倍

s.en: Q3 2026 results · before the US open
s.zh: 2026 Q3 业绩 · 美股开盘前

sub_price.en: Daily closes of the NASDAQ-listed shares with the 50-day average. Each ADR is one ordinary share. ASML has closed between about $1,550 and $1,990 since June.
sub_price.zh: 纳斯达克上市股份每日收盘价与50日均线。每份 ADR 即一股普通股。阿斯麦自6月以来收盘价在约 $1,550 至 $1,990 之间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. ASML reports in euros on a calendar year; each quarter is converted at that quarter's average EUR/USD rate (from about 1.01 in Q3 2022 to about 1.16–1.17 in 2025–26), so part of the dollar growth since 2025 is the stronger euro. EPS is per share (1 ADR = 1 share), converted the same way. The last bar is the midpoint of the €11.0–12.0B Q3 2026 guide at about 1.15 $/€.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。阿斯麦以欧元报告、财年为自然年；各季度按当季平均欧元兑美元汇率换算（由 2022 Q3 约 1.01 至 2025–26 年约 1.16–1.17），因此 2025 年以来的美元增长部分来自欧元走强。每股收益按每股计算（1 ADR = 1 股），同样换算。最后一根柱为 2026 Q3 指引 110–120 亿欧元的中值，按约 1.15 美元/欧元换算。

s.zh: 93.3 亿欧元 · 同比 +21% · 高于指引
38 亿欧元 · 16 台含 1 台 High NA · 每台约 2.3 亿欧元（估）
27.6 亿欧元 · 升级带动，高于指引约 3 亿

s.en: of system sales · 19% in Q1, 36% in Q4 25
s.zh: 系统销售占比 · Q1 为 19%，2025 Q4 为 36%
已停止披露 · 最后一次 132 亿欧元（2025 Q4），积压 388 亿

p.en: Management says 2027 low-NA EUV output is close to fully covered by orders. ASML plans about 30% more EUV (from ~65 to ~85 units) and immersion DUV capacity (from ~130) in 2027.
p.zh: 管理层表示 2027 年低数值孔径 EUV 产出已接近被订单全部覆盖。阿斯麦计划 2027 年将 EUV（由约 65 台增至约 85 台）及浸没式 DUV（约 130 台起）产能各提高约 30%。

p.en: Installed base sales of €2.76B beat guidance by about €300M as customers paid for productivity upgrades. Service and upgrade sales should grow more than 30% this year, and management says it has more room on pricing.
p.zh: 客户为提升产能购买升级，装机服务销售 27.6 亿欧元，高于指引约 3 亿。今年服务与升级销售预计增长超过 30%，管理层称定价空间更大。

p.en: ASML stopped reporting quarterly orders in 2026. The last figure was a record €13.2B in Q4 2025, with a €38.8B backlog, so the market now leans on what management says about 2027 and 2028.
p.zh: 阿斯麦自 2026 年起停止披露季度订单。最后一次为 2025 Q4 创纪录的 132 亿欧元，积压订单 388 亿欧元，因此市场只能依赖管理层对 2027 与 2028 年的表述。

p.en: The €11.0–12.0B Q3 guide is about 53% above last year's €7.5B at the midpoint, with gross margin of 55–57%. Analysts expect about $13.2B of revenue.
p.zh: Q3 指引 110–120 亿欧元，中值较去年同期 75 亿欧元高约 53%，毛利率 55–57%。分析师预期营收约 132 亿美元。

p.en: China fell to 14% of Q2 system sales but is still about 20% of full-year sales. The proposed US MATCH Act would block immersion DUV sales to China and could limit servicing there.
p.zh: 中国在 Q2 系统销售中的占比降至 14%，但仍约占全年销售的 20%。拟议中的美国 MATCH 法案将禁止向中国出售浸没式 DUV，并可能限制在华服务。

p.en: At about 55 times trailing earnings the stock prices in strong growth. It fell 15% in the two weeks after the July report even though guidance was raised.
p.zh: 按历史盈利约 55 倍，股价已反映强劲增长。7月财报即使上调指引，股价在随后两周仍下跌 15%。

p.en: Before the US open. Guide: €11.0–12.0B sales, 55–57% gross margin. Analysts expect about $13.2B revenue and EPS of about $12.1–12.5; first comments on 2027.
p.zh: 美股开盘前公布。指引：销售 110–120 亿欧元，毛利率 55–57%。分析师预期营收约 132 亿美元、每股收益约 $12.1–12.5；将首次评论 2027 年。

h.zh: 中期股息（纳斯达克除息日）

p.en: The dividend is announced with results on Oct 14 and paid Nov 4. The last interim dividend was €1.88 per share.
p.zh: 股息于 10月14日随业绩公布，11月4日派发。上次中期股息为每股 1.88 欧元。

p.en: Full-year results and the 2027 outlook. MarketScreener lists Jan 26; ASML has not confirmed the date.
p.zh: 全年业绩及 2027 年展望。MarketScreener 列为 1月26日，阿斯麦尚未确认。

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with ASML Holding N.V.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 ASML Holding N.V. 无关联。

guide: 2026年9月 · 110–120 亿欧元指引中值，按约 1.15 美元/欧元换算

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, converted from euros to US$ millions at each quarter's average EUR/USD rate, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，按各季平均欧元兑美元汇率换算为百万美元，涵盖 2021 Q3 至 2026 Q2 共 20 个季度。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 75.8 亿欧元 · 2026年6月30日 · 债务约 23 亿美元

read.en: ASML's cash flow is lumpy because customers pay large down payments on new orders, mostly in the fourth quarter. Free cash flow was $9.4B in Q4 2024 and $12.8B in Q4 2025, while Q1 is often negative (−$3.0B in Q1 2026). The last four quarters add up to about $11.7B.
read.zh: 阿斯麦现金流波动大，因为客户为新订单支付大额预付款，且多集中在第四季。2024 Q4 与 2025 Q4 自由现金流分别为 94 亿和 128 亿美元，而第一季常为负（2026 Q1 为 −30 亿）。近四季合计约 117 亿美元。

read.en: My base case takes Q3 sales from the €11.0–12.0B guide, assumes another large Q4 inflow from 2027 down payments (management says 2027 EUV is nearly fully booked), a negative Q1 as in past years, and capex of $450–600M a quarter as capacity is added. That gives about $12.7B over four quarters at about 1.15 $/€. The swing factors are the timing of down payments and the euro.
read.zh: 我的基准情景以 110–120 亿欧元指引推算 Q3 销售，假设 Q4 再有一笔来自 2027 年订单预付款的大额流入（管理层称 2027 年 EUV 已接近订满），Q1 如往年为负，扩产期间资本开支每季 4.5–6 亿美元。按约 1.15 美元/欧元计，四季自由现金流约 127 亿美元。变数在于预付款的时点与欧元汇率。

p.en: A €12B program runs to 2028. ASML bought €2.2B in the first half, and the pace rose to roughly €400M a week from late July.
p.zh: 120 亿欧元回购计划执行至 2028 年。上半年回购 22 亿欧元，7月下旬起节奏升至每周约 4 亿欧元。

p.en: Interim dividends of €1.88 a share cost about €720M a quarter; the 2025 total was €7.50 a share.
p.zh: 每股 1.88 欧元的中期股息每季约 7.2 亿欧元；2025 年全年股息为每股 7.50 欧元。

p.en: Capex has run at $350–750M a quarter. Adding about 30% EUV and DUV capacity for 2027 should push it higher.
p.zh: 资本开支每季约 3.5–7.5 亿美元。为 2027 年增加约 30% 的 EUV 和 DUV 产能，将推高这一数字。

p.en: Customers prepay for tools months ahead, which is why Q4 cash inflows are so large.
p.zh: 客户提前数月预付设备款，因此第四季现金流入特别大。

p.en: Gross margin of 54.0% in Q2, guided to 55–57% in Q3, on volume and upgrade mix.
p.zh: Q2 毛利率 54.0%，Q3 指引 55–57%，受规模与升级业务组合带动。

p.en: High-margin service and upgrade sales are expected to grow more than 30% this year.
p.zh: 高利润的服务与升级销售预计今年增长超过 30%。

bridgeNote.en: Starting cash converted at the Jun 30 rate (~1.14 $/€). Q4 down payments can move cash by several billion, and the buyback figure is my estimate from the recent pace.
bridgeNote.zh: 期初现金按 6月30日汇率（约 1.14 美元/欧元）换算。第四季预付款可使现金变动数十亿，回购金额为根据近期节奏的估算。

extraNote.en: Converted from euros at each quarter's average EUR/USD rate (for example 1.05 in Q1 2025 and 1.16 in Q2 2026).
extraNote.zh: 按各季平均欧元兑美元汇率由欧元换算（例如 2025 Q1 为 1.05，2026 Q2 为 1.16）。
